title: potentilla heptaphylla subsp. bouquoyana
intro: Potentilla heptaphylla subsp. bouquoyana, commonly known as Korean five-leaf potentilla, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family, Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used in Korean medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla heptaphylla subsp. bouquoyana have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in treating various diseases, including cancer, diabetes, and neurodegenerative disorders.
